verdict.rationale: Docs describe reading issues (Jira/GitHub), planning and writing code across files, running tests, staging changes, and opening PRs, plus explicit MCP examples like 'Implement features from issue trackers... create a PR on GitHub' and Slack-triggered PR creation from bug reports. This covers the full issue-to-PR loop end-to-end. Missing for 10: independent hands-on case study demonstrating a full issue-to-merged-PR cycle without manual intervention, and community evidence is mixed on reliability of unattended multi-step execution.
